[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Longest substring without repeating characters** [LC 3 · Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters](https://leetcode.com/problems/longest-substring-without-repeating-characters/){difficulty="Medium"}

Slide a window $[left, i]$ that never contains a repeat. When $s_i$ was last seen at position $p$ **inside** the window, move $left$ to $p + 1$. If $p$ is to the left of the window, $s_i$ is not a repeat and $left$ must not move — moving it back would let an old repeat into the window.

[Solved in full in @sec-test-p2-substring.]{.card-link}
